== Description ==

[[Robbie Hendon]] (left, grey SWCCG Players Committee cap, grey T-shirt, goatee, name tag) playing [[Nick Swedal]] (right, grey quarter-zip, short dark hair) in Game 6 at the [[2025 World Championship]] on 4 October 2025. Standing onlookers and background players unlabeled.
